title: PAR-20/7G.3 SORTENTSTABLE extension-dictionary alias refusal

finding.source: The SORTENTSTABLE validator requires a singleton ACAD_SORTENTS entry in its owner extension dictionary.
finding.coverageGap: The existing generated adapter route did not directly exercise a second differently named entry pointing to the same SORTENTSTABLE handle.
finding.scope: Negative-control coverage for one SORTENTSTABLE extension-dictionary graph only.

implementation: Extended the existing generated ASCII/Binary --sortents-adapter route with ACAD_SORTENTS_ALIAS targeting the same table handle.
The malformed graph must be refused before output publication and preserve the seeded destination.
After removing the alias, the same adapter exports successfully and the existing strict readback checks the SORTENTSTABLE identity and owner chain.
commitBlocker: The shared worktree is broadly dirty and Git metadata is read-only in this session.
